methodologyNotes: Each vendor's official pricing page was re-fetched on 2026-06-15: followupboss.com/pricing, wiseagent.com/pricing.asp, topproducer.com/pricing, resimpli.com/pricing, start.realvolve.com/trial (Realvolve's main realvolve.com pricing table does not render; the campaign trial signup page explicitly states the recurring single-user price), lofty.com/pricing, i.insiderealestate.com/kvcore-pricing, and boomtownroi.com/product-comparison. LionDesk was excluded (discontinued by Lone Wolf in 2025; successor publishes no pricing). REsimpli is included with a note it targets real estate investors, not traditional agents; its published prices are annual-billing monthly-equivalents. Lofty, kvCORE/BoldTrail, and BoomTown publish NO prices (all quote-only); their monthlyUsd is null. Realvolve's $79/mo is the explicit recurring price stated on the official trial signup page after a 14-day free trial; only the single-user tier is verifiable from official sources (team tiers unconfirmed, omitted rather than guessed). Annual discounts taken from official page language ('2 months free' = ~16.7%; 'save 15%' for Wise Agent; REsimpli 'save up to 29%'). All accessedAt 2026-06-15.

vendors.name: Follow Up Boss
vendors.provenance: All three plan prices confirmed exact on followupboss.com/pricing 2026-06-15 (Grow $69/user/mo, Pro $499/mo incl 10 users, Platform $1000/mo incl 30 users). Annual billing = 2 months free (~16.7%). Security page (followupboss.com/security) explicitly lists SOC 2 Type 2 and SOC 3 (also CASA Tier 2, CCPA, PCI); no HIPAA or GDPR claim.

plans.name: Grow
plans.notes: Per user per month. Annual billing $58/user/mo (2 months free, ~16.7%). Calling add-on $39/user/mo monthly ($33/user/mo annual). Unlimited contacts.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Flat $499/mo includes 10 users; additional users $49/mo. Annual billing $416/mo. Unlimited calling/texting, team inboxes, call reporting, AI features.

plans.name: Platform
plans.notes: Flat $1,000/mo includes 30 users; additional users $20/mo ($17/mo annual). Annual billing $833/mo. Teams within teams, dedicated Success Manager, priority support.

limits: Grow plan: 1 user per seat license
enrichment.provenance: Pricing fetched from official pricing page; SOC 2 Type 2 and SOC 3 confirmed from official security page. No HIPAA or GDPR certification claimed.

vendors.name: Wise Agent
vendors.provenance: Prices confirmed on wiseagent.com/pricing.asp 2026-06-15: CRM $49/mo flat ($42/mo annual, $499/yr), CRM+WiseSocial $69/mo flat ($59/mo annual, $699/yr). 14-day free trial. Up to 5 team members on shared login. No compliance certifications stated.

plans.name: CRM
plans.notes: Flat $49/mo or $42/mo billed annually ($499/yr, ~15% off). Up to 5 team members on shared login, full CRM, 24/7 live support, onboarding, unlimited document storage, 100 lead enhancement credits, drip campaigns, transaction management.

plans.name: CRM + WiseSocial
plans.notes: Flat $69/mo or $59/mo billed annually ($699/yr). Everything in CRM plus WiseSocial: social automation, automated listing posting, branded listing videos, scheduling.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing for teams of 15+ agents. Bulk licensing, white-label, custom configs. Contact for quote.

limits: CRM plan: up to 5 team members on shared login (additional 5-packs at $20/mo)
keyFeatures: Flat-rate pricing with up to 5 shared logins included
WiseSocial add-on for automated listing social posts
enrichment.provenance: Pricing confirmed from official pricing page. No compliance certifications listed.

vendors.name: Top Producer
vendors.provenance: All six prices confirmed exact on topproducer.com/pricing 2026-06-15: Pro $179/user/mo, Pro+Leads from $479/mo, Pro+Farming from $599/mo, Pro Teams 5 $399/mo, Pro Teams 10 $699/mo, Pro Teams 25 $1199/mo. No annual discount, no free trial, no compliance certifications published.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Per user per month. Market Snapshot reports with MLS data, automated SMS/email lead response, transaction management, MLS integration (320+ boards).

plans.name: Pro + Leads
plans.notes: Starting at $479/mo; final price varies by lead volume. Everything in Pro plus Social Connect, exclusive social-media leads, automated multi-touch responses.

plans.name: Pro + Farming
plans.notes: Starting at $599/mo; final price varies by farm size. Everything in Pro plus Smart Targeting, predictive farming analytics, automated multi-channel marketing.

plans.name: Pro Teams 5
plans.notes: Up to 5 users per month. Everything in Pro, team functionality, shared contact access, option to add Farming and Leads.

plans.name: Pro Teams 10
plans.notes: Up to 10 users per month. Everything in Pro, team functionality, shared contact access, option to add Farming and Leads.

plans.name: Pro Teams 25
plans.notes: Up to 25 users per month. Everything in Pro, team functionality, shared contact access, option to add Farming and Leads.

limits: Pro + Leads and Pro + Farming prices vary by lead volume and farm size (floor prices shown)
keyFeatures: Social Connect for lead generation from social media
enrichment.provenance: All six plan prices confirmed exact from official pricing page. No annual discount, free trial, or compliance certifications found.

vendors.name: Realvolve
vendors.provenance: The main realvolve.com pricing table does not render via fetch. The official campaign trial signup page (start.realvolve.com) explicitly states: 'Experience the power of Realvolve free for 14 days. Then just $79/month for your single user plan.' $79/mo is therefore the genuine recurring single-user price (not a trial teaser). Team-tier prices could NOT be verified from official sources and are omitted rather than guessed. Third-party aggregators vary ($39-$99), so single-user price is held at medium confidence.

plans.name: Pro (Single User)
plans.notes: Single-user plan at $79/month after a 14-day free trial, per the official trial signup page ('then just $79/month for your single user plan'). This is the recurring price, not the trial teaser. Team-tier prices not published on any rendering official page; omitted to avoid a guess.

limits: Single-user price $79/mo verified; team pricing requires contacting vendor
Main realvolve.com pricing table did not render via fetch
keyFeatures: Workflow automation for real estate transactions
enrichment.provenance: Single-user recurring price of $79/month confirmed from the official Realvolve trial signup page. Main pricing table did not render; team plan prices unverifiable from official sources and omitted.

vendors.name: REsimpli

REsimpli targets real estate investors (wholesalers, flippers), not traditional sales agents/brokers.

plans.name: Basic

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $299/month billed annually. Up to 5 users, 100,000 list records, 1,000 calling minutes/mo, 20,000 skip tracing credits. Additional users $89/mo.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: $599/month billed annually. Up to 10 users, unlimited list records, 5,000 calling minutes/mo, 50,000 skip tracing credits. Additional users $79/mo.

limits: Prices shown are annual billing; month-to-month rates not published
keyFeatures: All-in-one for real estate investors: CRM + dialer + SMS + skip tracing + direct mail
Gen 2 AI agents available as add-on bundles
enrichment.provenance: Pricing confirmed from official pricing page; all prices are annual-billing monthly-equivalents. REsimpli is investor-focused, not a traditional agent/broker CRM.
